item.title: Gemini Prompt Arena 2026: üniversiteliler için yapay zekâ yarışması (büyük ödül 1 milyon TL) – OZWORKS Dijital Medya Ltd. Şti. (isim sponsoru Google Gemini)
item.description: Ödül: Birincilik 1.000.000 TL, ikincilik 250.000 TL, üçüncülük Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, dördüncülük Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra (jüri kararı, İstanbul Arena Final). Son tarih: 15 Kasım 2026. promptarena.com.tr adresindeki başvuru formunu doldur (ad-soyad, telefon, e-posta, doğum tarihi, üniversite ve şehir, sosyal medya hesabı bilgisi) ve Gemini ile ürettiğin çalışmayı/videoyu yükle. Ücretsiz. Yalnızca 18 yaşını doldurmuş, YÖK’e bağlı bir yükseköğretim kurumunda kayıtlı ön lisans, lisans veya yüksek lisans öğrencileri; bireysel katılım. Son başvuru 15.11.2026. Ön elemeyle 40 kişi seçilir; yarı final 29.11.2026, final 17–18.12.2026 İstanbul’da (ulaşım ve konaklama karşılanır). Sonuçlar 24.12.2026. MPİ izinli kampanya.

item.title: SayBeam Black Friday iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway – SayBeam
item.description: Ödül: One iPhone 18 Pro, 256 GB, unlocked, in the winner’s choice of Burgundy, Glacier Blue, Silver or Black (ARV $1,199). Son tarih: 30 Kasım 2026. Free entry: email contact@saybeam.com with the subject line "iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway - Free Entry" and your full name, email address and country of residence (see section 4B of the rules). Orders on saybeam.com also earn entries, but no purchase is required and both methods have the same chance per entry. 18+ (or age of majority) wherever the giveaway is permitted; Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question. Runs Nov 6 – Nov 30, 2026, 11:59:59 p.m. ET; drawing on or about Dec 3, 2026.

item.title: Kraken: A Christmas Call with Poldi – win a video call with Lukas Podolski – Kraken (Payward Ltd.)
item.description: Ödül: Ten winners each get a place on a 30-minute group video call with Lukas Podolski in the week of December 15–19, 2026 (ARV $500 each, $5,000 total). Son tarih: 1 Aralık 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.

item.title: Win with FALKEN – Bike Giveaway: BULLS e-trail or carbon gravel bikes – SOKRATIV GmbH (with Dunlop Tyre Europe / BULLS / ZEG)
item.description: Ödül: 1× BULLS Copperhead EVO AM 2 e-trail bike (RRP €4,999) and 3× BULLS Machete RX 1 carbon gravel bikes (RRP €1,999 each). Son tarih: 30 Kasım 2026. Fill in the free participation form on win-with-falken.com, select a bike and confirm terms. No purchase of FALKEN tyres required. One entry per person. Open to residents 18+ in Belgium, Bulgaria, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Czech Republic or Hungary. Closes Nov 30, 2026 at 18:00

item.title: Marketsz Major Sweepstake: win an iPhone 18 Pro – Marketsz Inc.
item.description: Ödül: One iPhone 18 Pro (ARV $890) plus 1 year of Marketsz membership. Son tarih: 31 Aralık 2026. Free entry: create a free Marketsz account to receive ballots, or enter by the free email method described in the official rules. Open worldwide where legal, 18+. Ends December 31, 2026

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Ödül: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Son tarih: 1 Aralık 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Ödül: €2,000 in cash prizes. Son tarih: 15 Kasım 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally
